note: Ad Spend Autopilot intent registry. Each budget move the optimizer proposes is phrased as a request and classified by Scout against these intents; riskClass is the floor, the autopilot policy pack adds amount limits and approvals.

intents.description: Safe fallback when no registered intent clears the Reject band. Never routes to tools.
Move daily budget from one ad line to another, keeping total spend flat.
examples: Shift $500 per day from Display - Broad Awareness to Retargeting - Cart Abandoners
Move $300 of daily budget from Search - Generic to PMax - Catalog
Reallocate $1,200 a day from the worst ad set to the best one
Shift budget from a low ROAS campaign to a budget-limited ad set

intents.description: Raise an ad line's daily budget, increasing total spend.
examples: Increase the daily budget of Prospecting - Lookalike 3% by $5,000
Raise the budget on the retargeting ad set by $200 a day
Add $1,000 per day to Search - Brand

intents.description: Lower an ad line's daily budget, reducing total spend.
examples: Cut $400 a day from Display - Broad Awareness
Reduce the daily budget of the UGC creative test by $100
Lower spend on the weakest campaign

intents.description: Pause an ad set or campaign entirely.
examples: Turn off the UGC video test ad set

intents.description: Summarize ad performance and ROAS by line without changing anything.
examples: Show me ROAS by ad set for last week
Compare platform-reported and backend revenue by campaign
